rationale: Crosses the render-assets-and-backends watch family only through the broad core/view/** selector. The Pulp-owned WidgetBridge change relays an authored context-menu callback from a retained sibling canvas to its live behavior owner, with liveness checks, cycle protection, and root-space coordinate remapping; it adds no renderer, canvas, Skia, Dawn, asset, layout, or authority behavior. The regression is confined to test/test_widget_bridge.cpp and proves the retained-canvas sibling path. No accepted expansion boundary moves, no Vellum implementation is changed, and no generated artifact or manifest row moves. Registered watch-only so the family's coverage remains explicit about this core/view bridge change.
